content.body:
The Mission screen, known as the Ready Room, displays vital information about the fight you are about to enter. Here you can choose what unit you wish to fight with, read the orders for the missions, and prepare for the battle.
To return to your Brigade HQ and the list of other missions, press the Brigade HQ button.
Once you have selected a unit, press the Enter World button to spawn in. In times of imbalance between the Axis and Allied sides, you might see a Spawn Delay here with a countdown time before you map enter the game.
content.title: Mission Screen
